expected_differences_not_mismatches: exporter audio_after_window_excluded_s is None (not 0) when a session has no in-window audio; parser reports the actual post-T seconds (vad500 pause/7,25,51,170; vad800 pause/116,20; vad1200 pause/211,23). Recorder initial_delay_s for those 8 sessions equals the parser first_audio_s (|diff| < 2e-5 s), confirming the audio is real post-T audio.

spotcheck.py's own sample array uses ceil(T*24000) whereas the parser/exporter crop at float T*24000; differs by 1 sample (42 us) only when T*24000 is non-integer (semmed turn_taking/107, T=16.7999375). Parser identity in_window == survived+cut+cropped holds exactly in all 1337 sessions.

the first run of spotcheck.py flagged responses_deferred / tt_final_response_id in 5 vad500 sessions; that was a bug in the checker (it compared response.created against commits that had not happened yet). Fixed to event-order linking; the CSV values were correct.
